component.name: WayPeek
component.summary: Window spy for Wayland - a kdotool GUI

description.p: WayPeek shows real-time information about the window under the cursor and the current mouse position, inspired by the Window Spy tool from AutoHotKey on Windows.
Hold the assigned "freeze" shortcut to pause updates, or use the toggle shortcut to lock the display in place while you inspect values.
